networkPolicy.desc: Navigation works; the old photo hosts and the photo endpoint are blocked, but place photos still reach the app through the main Maps connection

notes:
Every host is written out, and that is the whole point of this file. Upstream blocks "*.googleusercontent.com", which reads as a wildcard and is not one: in this data format the star is dropped and a www twin added, so it expands to googleusercontent.com and www.googleusercontent.com and matches nothing that serves a photograph. See KDroidHosts in the application for the evidence.

The numbered families are written out in full, 0 through 9, because the device proved that guessing the range is how photographs get through. A first pass covered lh3 through lh6 and the photographs kept arriving; the log said why:

    lh3.googleusercontent.com -> 0.0.0.0
    gz0.googleusercontent.com -> 216.239.38.135

gz0 was not on the list and was serving them. Listing a range that does not exist yet costs nothing; leaving one out costs the whole rule.

Note that gz0.googleusercontent.com answered on the same address as mobilemaps-pa-gz.googleapis.com, which is why this file blocks names and never addresses.

encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com was found serving the photographs in the attractions tab (seen on a device, 2026-10-20). It is Google's image thumbnail host, the same one image search uses, and nothing the map needs; the family is written out 0 through 9 for the reason above.

WHAT THIS FILE NO LONGER ACHIEVES (measured on a device, 2026-11-22). Place photos, including user uploads, load again in the place sheet and gallery. Maps no longer asks for any lh*, gz*, ggpht or encrypted-tbn host at all: after a cold start it opens one connection to mobilemaps.googleapis.com (216.239.38.135, shared with mobilemaps-pa-gz.googleapis.com) plus googlevideo.com, and the photographs come in over that connection.

mobilemaps-pa-gz.googleapis.com is blocked because blocking it costs nothing: with it blocked, search, a 147 km route with traffic and alternatives, and the map itself all worked, which disproves the earlier note that it carries the map. It removed the photo gallery for some places (Ein Gedi) and not for others (Gordon Beach), because Maps reuses the mobilemaps.googleapis.com connection for the same requests.

mobilemaps.googleapis.com cannot be blocked: with it blocked, search spins forever. A filter that judges by name or address cannot separate the photographs from the map on one connection, so the catalog entry carries hasUnmodestImage instead. googlevideo.com (short place videos) cannot be listed either: its hosts are per-node names such as rr1---sn-u1ua85-5i.googlevideo.com, and *. is not a wildcard in this format.
